alternatives: One universal engineering agent with all procedures always loaded
Implicit free-form routing chosen anew for every request
A loose collection of unrelated prompts without shared ownership
A large workflow framework with persistent orchestration state
counterpressure: Every additional owner increases routing and relationship proof cost
Always-loaded procedure consumes context needed for the repository task
Overlapping owners create ambiguous authority and duplicate completion
Automation can verify structure but cannot safely choose semantic outcomes
Human interaction is valuable for unsettled commitments but costly as ceremony
discovered_methods: Use one explicit router that recommends one next owner and stops
Separate repository setup, domain meaning, evidence, shaping, delivery, and review authority
Use bounded leaf outcomes behind small caller-facing interfaces
Use executable aggregates only for named multi-owner outcomes with explicit resume and exit ownership
Separate prototypes, diagnosis, and red-green implementation by uncertainty state
Separate ordinary diff review, high-risk convergence, and immutable baseline audit
Preserve exact handoff and tracker state at session and concurrency boundaries
Keep semantic decisions human or owner-controlled and mechanical validation pure
failures: The agent begins execution before selecting the correct authority owner
Repository prerequisites or domain invariants are discovered after mutation
Prior vocabulary or incumbent procedure anchors fresh composition
Evidence gathering silently becomes adoption or product judgment
Unsettled intent is converted directly into implementation
Prototype, diagnosis, and production proof are conflated
Parallel workers share scarce state or semantic decisions
Review mutates the candidate or implementation admits partial findings
A workflow duplicates a callee's gates, mutation, Return, or completion
Context grows through copied foreign procedure instead of conditional loading
Tracker, Git, or session state is reported complete without exact read-back
intended_essence: A compact engineering skill pack that routes bounded repository work to one clear owner, loads procedure conditionally, composes only through typed relationships, preserves domain and authority boundaries, and converges under observable proof.
m0_units: Choose one next engineering owner without starting it
Reconcile the target repository's setup and governing context before work
Clarify and persist domain meaning and durable decisions
Acquire bounded external or stakeholder evidence without adopting outcomes
Shape foggy work into a settled source, specification, and dependency-ordered queue
Classify incoming work into an executable or human-owned state
Design or probe one bounded seam when implementation technique is uncertain
Diagnose uncertain failure before fixing and use red-green proof when behavior is settled
Deliver one selected item or one explicit ticket graph with isolated authority
Resolve version-control conflicts without discarding either intended side
Review ordinary changes, high-risk candidates, and immutable baselines at distinct boundaries
Improve or simplify code without hiding scope expansion
Author and behaviorally validate canonical skill instructions
Stress-test decisions with or without durable domain capture
Preserve a resumable exact handoff when the active context must end
wrong_conditions: A direct self-contained answer needs no repository workflow
A commitment-changing decision lacks caller authority
Required external facts are unavailable and cannot be safely inferred
The requested action is irreversible or outside the granted mutation boundary
No observable proof seam exists for the claimed behavior
